instruction.text: Look at the words below and decide whether they are adverbials of time, place or number.
Select the correct adverbial to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
My dog Misty is recovering really well after her treatment, and she is nearly back to normal. The vets have been amazing at helping her through the recovery.

((++Last_month, Under_the_table, Lastly,)) she hurt her back playing in the park. She seemed to be in a lot of pain.

Delia is going on a camping trip next weekend. She is going to stay in Scotland. She needs to pack lots of things such as food and water. She also needs to buy a new tent.

((Next_month, ++In_the_shop, Tomorrow,)) she looked at all the different tents so that she could find the best option.

Ollie is in a lot of trouble with his mum as he did not listen to her instructions. His room is very messy and dirty.

((++Twice, Next_week, Behind,)) she told him to tidy and clean his room, but he did not listen. Now Ollie is grounded for being rude and for not listening.

instruction.text: Select the correct word or phrase to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
Howel enjoys playing football at the weekend. He goes to the park every Saturday to practice.

((++On_the_other_hand Additionally)), Robyn does not enjoy playing football; they much prefer playing rugby and train every Wednesday.

Syon is very good at learning languages. He can speak French, German, Hindi and Spanish.

((++In_addition However)), Syon is currently trying to learn how to speak Greek. He goes to a night class every Monday after work.

instruction.text: Link the paragraphs together based on the repetition.

atoms.a: I find horror films interesting. Most of the time, they have a good storyline and engaging characters.
atoms.b: Although I find horror films interesting, they can also be extremely frightening.

atoms.a: The red squirrel is an endangered animal in the UK. The grey squirrel population has caused the red squirrel population to reduce in size.
atoms.b: However, in Germany, the red squirrel is not an endangered animal. Most of the squirrels in Germany are red.
